name: Banh kho me
summary: Bánh khô mè is a sesame cake of glutinous rice flour, sesame, and sugar. The 16 Apr 2024 city page says the known name in Da Nang is the Cẩm Lệ cake, bought as a gift and for offerings at anniversaries and Tết.
origin: Quảng Nam and Da Nang, on the 4 Jul 2023 OCOP page for bánh khô mè Bà Liễu mẹ, which calls it a traditional gift cake of the city.
culture: The 16 Apr 2024 page says people in Da Nang buy it to offer first and share after, at giỗ and at Tết. The OCOP page gives the workshop as K200/1 Ông Ích Đường, Cẩm Lệ, and also names the airport and souvenir shops.
howToEat: Take it home as a gift, or buy it for an offering. The pages do not describe a sauce.
where: K200/1 Ông Ích Đường, Cẩm Lệ, on the 4 Jul 2023 page, plus the airport and specialty shops named there. A shop hour is Check on arrival.
